# Negative-control fixture for the individual "subheading-relation"
# feature (see briefings/individual-SKOS-broader-relation.org).
#
# Identical individual nesting to skos-individuals.org, but with NO
# :ELOT-subheading-relation: drawer anywhere.  The generated OMN must
# therefore contain no Facts: axioms at all -- proving the feature is
# inert unless the property is present, so existing files tangle
# unchanged.

#+title: SKOS subheading-relation negative control

:ELOT-context-type: ontology
:ELOT-context-localname: skos-none
:ELOT-default-prefix: ex
:END:

:prefixdefs: yes
:END:

| skos:  | http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core# |
